section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the 13-item Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), including its scoring (5-point items, averaged, with two reverse-scored items) and reported psychometric support (e.g., α = .93; temporal stability r =.90 among college females; α = .94 for women and α = .92 for men in adult samples). It also notes use of a version translated for Brazilian young adolescents and references prior administrations in college and adult samples; no sample sizes, survey method, BMI assessment method, or BA–BMI correlations are reported here.
section_summary.evidence_source: This 13-item instrument evaluates the appreciation of the body (love, care for, protect and preserve the body), an aspect of positive body image (Avalos et al., 2005). The BAS factor structure comprises a single dimension that shows adequate internal consistency (α = .93) and good temporal stability over a period of three weeks apart (r =.90, p <.001) among college females. BAS study in Brazilian young adolescents will be taken from the version translated by Swami et al. (2011) for adults of both sexes.
